name: @convax/desktop
description: A desktop visual workspace for connected canvases, projects, plugins, and AI-assisted work.
author: Convax contributors

scripts.dev: bun run build:workspace-dependencies && bun run collaboration:prepare && bun run marketplace:prepare:dev && bun scripts/ensure-electron-runtime.ts && electron-vite dev
scripts.build: bun run build:workspace-dependencies && bun run collaboration:prepare && electron-vite build
scripts.marketplace:prepare: bun run marketplace:verify && bun scripts/materialize-marketplace-product-lock.ts ../../marketplaces.lock.json .packaging/marketplace-cache && bun scripts/stage-marketplace-product-lock.ts ../../marketplaces.lock.json .packaging/marketplace-cache/artifact-v1
scripts.package:prepare: bun run marketplace:prepare && bun run build && bun scripts/ensure-electron-runtime.ts && bun scripts/stage-packaged-runtime.ts
scripts.smoke:offline-restart: bun scripts/ensure-electron-runtime.ts && bun run build && bun ../../scripts/desktop-offline-restart-smoke.ts
scripts.smoke:open-project: bun scripts/ensure-electron-runtime.ts && bun run build && bun ../../scripts/desktop-open-project-built-smoke.ts
